name: failure-memory
description: Remember real agent failures in one fast call and recall durable local lessons across harnesses.

interface.shortDescription: Remember real failures quickly without saving requirement changes.
interface.longDescription: Uses one recording call to distinguish real failures from requirement changes, preserve evidence-bounded root causes and proposed repairs, reuse exact lessons, and append telemetry. All installed harnesses recall from one owner-private global memory.
defaultPrompt: Evaluate whether this correction is a real failure.
Recall relevant lessons before I continue.
